name: @activepieces/piece-oneclickimpact
description: Make a positive environmental impact with every transaction.

captureCarbon.name: captureCarbon
captureCarbon.description: Capture carbon for yourself or on behalf of the customer

amount.description: The amount of carbon to capture in lbs (1 and 10,000,000)

customerEmail.description: The email of the customer on whose behalf the carbon is being captured

customerName.description: The name of the customer on whose behalf the carbon is being captured

aiMetadata.description: Purchases carbon capture through 1ClickImpact for a given amount (in lbs, 1 to 10,000,000), optionally attributed to a named customer email/name. Use to offset emissions as part of a transaction or fulfillment flow. Not idempotent — each call records a new capture, so repeating it captures additional carbon.

cleanOcean.name: cleanOcean
cleanOcean.description: Clean  ocean waste yourself or on behalf of the customer

amount.description: The amount of ocean waste to clean in lbs (1 and 10,000,000)

customerEmail.description: The email of the customer on whose behalf the ocean waste is being cleaned

customerName.description: The name of the customer on whose behalf the ocean waste is being cleaned

aiMetadata.description: Purchases ocean-waste cleanup through 1ClickImpact for a given amount (in lbs, 1 to 10,000,000), optionally attributed to a named customer email/name. Use to fund cleanup as part of a transaction or fulfillment flow. Not idempotent — each call records a new cleanup, so repeating it cleans additional waste.

donateMoney.name: donateMoney
donateMoney.description: Donate money to support environmental causes

amount.description: The amount in USD you wish to donate. Minimum $1.00

customerEmail.description: The email of the customer on whose behalf the donation is being made

customerName.description: The name of the customer on whose behalf the donation is being made

aiMetadata.description: Makes a monetary donation to environmental causes through 1ClickImpact for an amount in USD (minimum $1.00, converted to cents internally), optionally attributed to a named customer email/name. Use to fund impact as part of a transaction or fulfillment flow. Not idempotent — each call records a new donation, so repeating it donates again.

plantTrees.name: plantTrees
plantTrees.description: Plant trees for yourself or on behalf of the customer

amount.description: The number of trees to plant (1 and 10,000,000)

customerEmail.description: The email of the customer on whose behalf the trees are being planted

customerName.description: The name of the customer on whose behalf the trees are being planted

aiMetadata.description: Purchases tree planting through 1ClickImpact for a given number of trees (1 to 10,000,000), optionally attributed to a named customer email/name. Use to fund reforestation as part of a transaction or fulfillment flow. Not idempotent — each call records a new planting, so repeating it plants additional trees.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
